plans.idea: Product-left split: a large can fills the left column while the right column reads top to bottom (logo, headline and subline, then CTA), all sharing one left edge, so the product is the big image and the copy sits at a readable size.
A faithful centred stack like the original (logo, then can, then headline and subline, then a centred pill CTA) on one central axis, with the copy given the full width so the headline stays large.

Headline first: a small centred logo, then a full-width headline band across the top half as the main focus, with the product and the CTA side by side in the bottom row so the eye goes from brand to message to product to action.
